text:
IncidentBot: [ALERT] 1794123000 - High 429 spike detected on inference-api-prod (10m error rate 8.4% > threshold 2.0%). Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/d/xyz/ingest-429s (automated snapshots attached). Pager: eng-oncall.
Alex G: on it. seeing a steady climb starting ~1794122400. any initial tangent? :thinking_face:
Maria T: +1. Are these originating from a specific tenant or route? can we get per-tenant 429 breakdown from the dashboard?
IncidentBot: Per-tenant top contributors (last 10m): acme-corp 43%, fastshop 18%, analytics-inc 9%, others 30%.
Raman P: that's concentrated. I'm going to apply a short-term traffic shaping rule for the top noisy tenant and drop retries for backend fallback to reduce queueing.
Alex G: ok. propose mitigation sequence: 1) soft rate-limit top tenant to 20 rps 2) disable non-critical telemetry endp /bulk-embed for that tenant 3) bump worker slots to burst pool if needed 4) monitor 429/503 trend. sound good?
Maria T: SGTM. also suggest toggling prefix-KV cache for that tenant (might reduce compute) — low risk.
SRE Lead: prioritize minimal customer-visible disruption. prefer gradual limit and clear comms. prepare to rollback.
Alex G: executing soft limit now. command: ```sh
redwoodctl traffic-shaper apply --tenant acme-corp --policy soft-rate-limit --limit 20rps --duration 15m
```
OpsBot: action accepted. Change id: cs-1794123000-rt1. Preview: soft-rate-limit -> 20 rps for acme-corp.
Alex G: applied. Monitor shows immediate drop in 429s for acme-corp but overall cluster 429s still elevated (aggregated down 30%).
Maria T: applying disable of /bulk-embed for acme-corp: ```json
PATCH /configs/tenants/acme-corp/features
{ "bulk_embed_enabled": false }
```
OpsBot: feature toggle applied. id: ft-1794123045.
Raman P: enabling KV prefix caching for acme-corp. This will warm up for next few requests. Command: ```sh
redwoodctl cache enable --tenant acme-corp --type prefix-kv
```
Juniper: watch the 503s too — edge shows some 503 spikes coincident with upstream timeouts. Could be retries. throttling retries might help.
Alex G: turning off client-side long retries via ingress policy for acme-corp: ```yaml
ingress:
  tenants:
    acme-corp:
      retry_policy: "none"
```
OpsBot: ingress policy updated. id: ing-1794123090.
SRE Lead: good. also patching the dashboard with a short-lived panel showing per-tenant 429/503 and percent of cluster requests. link (live): https://dash.redwood.internal/d/xyz/ingest-429s?view=mitigation-179412
Maria T: early customer impact assessment: estimated affected requests ~ 6% of platform RPS, but 12 tenants seeing elevated errors. Top 3 tenants account for ~70% of error volume. Potentially 4000 failed requests/min at peak.
Alex G: summary so far: rate-limit + feature toggle + cache + retry suppression. immediate effect: cluster 429 rate down from 8.4% to 3.1% over 6 minutes. 503s steady but not increasing.
Raman P: observing backend queue depth reduced ~45% on inference workers. No overload alerts on GPU nodes. Looks like contention at front-end ingress queues.
Juniper: leaving a note for status page: draft incident blurb -> "We are mitigating elevated 429 errors affecting a subset of tenants by applying temporary rate-limiting, feature toggles, and retry controls. Root cause under investigation. Customers may see transient failures; we expect improvement within 30 minutes."
Alex G: @SRE Lead, want to start on-call handoff in 20 minutes; if metrics stay stable we can keep soft limits for another 30m then rollback incrementally. Otherwise, escalate.
SRE Lead: agree. @Raman P you take next 30m ownership for live mitigation and post updates. I'll prepare post-incident checklist and assign follow-ups (dashboard alert tuning, tenant throttling playbook).
Raman P: taking handoff. I'll keep watch and will escalate to infra if 503s grow >1% or 429s plateau above 2.5%.
Maria T: pinging Solutions Eng to inform top impacted customers (acme-corp, fastshop) with mitigation steps and ETA. cc: @Juniper
Alex G: recorded commands and change ids in incident ticket INC-1794. please add any notes to that ticket.
OpsBot: change cs-1794123000-rt1 closed as successful at 1794123300. ft-1794123045 active. ing-1794123090 active.
IncidentBot: [UPDATE] 1794123440 - 429 rate now 1.9% cluster-wide; acme-corp 1.2%. 503 rate 0.08%. Rolling back soft-rate-limit in 10m if stable.
Juniper: tentative rollback plan: increase acme-corp limit to 60rps -> monitor 5m -> if stable remove limit. prepare rollback command ready.
Raman P: acknowledged. leaving watch. Handoff note: next oncall @alex-g in 00:20 UTC. My pager will remain open until 1794124020.
Alex G: thanks all. I'll post a short status update on #incidents and ping accounts team. :thumbsup:
